# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- WalkieTalkie is a 2-person lobby chat app: text chat plus hold-to-talk
  (walkie-talkie) voice, where speech is converted to text and read aloud on
  the other person's device via TTS.
- Chat messages are group-scoped: users must share a group to see each other's
  messages and hear each other's voice.
- Ask for permission to save preferences only once; avoid repeating 'Memory detected' prompts.
